messages.text: Does the harlo run on a standard 120v outlet
Read the bsb b30 page
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 miner

Yes. The B30 has a built-in 540 W supply rated 100 to 240 V, and it pulls 485 W at the wall in Turbo, about 4 amps on 120 V. Any normal 15 A household outlet handles it, and it ships with the US cord.

Same answer for the Magic Miner 40T you're looking at: 100-240 V input, about 650 W, roughly 5.5 amps. Just don't stack several miners plus a heater on one circuit.

Which one are you leaning toward?
Magic miner
Used the store-orders skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Good pick. Worth flagging though: you already have a Magic Miner 40T on order, Shop···· from October 19, ships December 7, 2026. Same unit, same price.

Is this a second one you're after, or were you checking on that one? If it's a second, two 40Ts is about 1,300 W, so I'd put them on separate 120 V circuits.
So I can definitely use a standard 120v outlet for the magic miner

Yes. The 40T's built-in PSU is rated 100-240 V, 50/60 Hz, with a standard IEC C14 inlet, and it ships with the US cord. At 650 W in Standard mode it draws about 5.5 amps on 120 V, well inside a normal 15 amp outlet.

One caution: give it a circuit that isn't already loaded with a space heater, microwave or a second miner. Running 24/7 at that draw, you want headroom.
Yes, just checking on the one I just ordered

Got it. Shop···· is paid and in the queue, your Magic Miner 40T ships December 7, 2026, along with the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA on the same order. Nothing needed from you until then, tracking comes by email when it leaves.

So plug-wise you're all set: standard 120 V outlet, cord in the box.

Last one: what part are you least sure about, the pool setup or the networking side?
Equally both

Thanks, that's genuinely useful to know.

Both are easier than they look, and you won't be doing it alone. Our Discord is the fastest place for setup help, JD and the community are in there daily: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Enjoy the 40T when it lands in December. If you were happy with how this went, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com
